title: Cutuukâ Diifih Goranah Asmatah
intro: taswiir soolam gubal fidin bar qaraanal, iffonta ugtam wagittam kee tokkeek baytam nummaak kibal taguudeh tanim gorrisak. ku dariifal, tibba le muucitte faatit kee fida geytam, uxih qado sabab esseroora ken cayla. meysi sinni xongolo qaadoodi gexkalit kee ximmo qaran kee ardi gine.
clues: Anu cutuukaay, alsa kee ayro fan wagteeh, oson yi Rabbi yakkem maduudan sababitte culteeh, bayteemih taagah.
Anu yi ummatta Yallak kalah qibaadah tanim qaduuk sadak, Gine dubuk qibaadah ken seece.
Anu mano kee raba yaceem iyyah yan kibal le miraacat anaakar abeeh, Yalli ayro mawqak baaheh yaniimih galab xagak gacse.
Anu sanamitte yoogoreh ken yiggileh, dubuk keenik nabam cabe tonnal ummatta teetih tadaarem bictah.
Anu inni ummatta yibbixeeh, nacsimeeh, xisne xisaanam kee cararta girat yoo qideenim warsan.
Yalli gira xabcaa kee amaan yoh takkuh amrise waqdi cattiimeh.

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
verse: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]. (6:75)
